en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to us by Muhammad b. Ibrahim who said it was narrated to us by Ibn Sahl Harun b. Muhammad Zanjalah who said it was narrated to us by Abu al-Abbas Ahmad b. Hameed who said it was narrated to us by Abu Salih from Sa’d b. Sa’eed from Abi Tayyibah from Nur b. Wabarah from al-Rabee’ b. Khatheem from Abdillah b. Mas’ud from The Prophet (s.a.w.s.) from Jibra’il from Israfeel from His Lord May He be glorified and exalted that he said:
‘and ask His forgiveness; surely He is oft-returning (to mercy).’
This gift is special to me and my Ummah. The prophets and their people before me did not get this gift.”
